name: time-tracker
description: Track time spent on tasks with start/stop/pause/resume.
skillSummary: Track time spent working on tasks. Start, stop, pause, and resume timers. View session history and daily summaries.

tools.name: time-tracker.start
tools.description: Start tracking time for a task. Use when the user wants to begin working on something.

taskName.description: Name of the task to track

tools.name: time-tracker.stop
tools.description: Stop the active timer and record the session.

sessionId.description: Session ID to stop. If omitted, stops the most recent active session.

tools.name: time-tracker.pause
tools.description: Pause the active timer without ending the session.

sessionId.description: Session ID to pause. If omitted, pauses the active session.
Session ID to resume. If omitted, resumes the paused session.

tools.name: time-tracker.status
tools.description: Check currently running or paused sessions. Only shows IN-PROGRESS sessions, not past history.

tools.name: time-tracker.history
tools.description: Get past completed sessions with durations. Use this for 'show history', 'what did I work on', 'how long did I track'. Do NOT use time-tracker.status for history.

date.description: Date to filter by (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to all recent sessions.

proactive.name: long-session-reminder
proactive.description: Remind you to take a break after working for a long time

proactive.name: daily-summary
proactive.description: Send a summary of today's tracked time at end of day
